worldcombat.skill.terablast.summary: Crystallize your primary type: higher Attack hurls a heavy crystal spear that shatters on the first target and knocks it back; higher Sp. Atk fires a fixed-direction narrow beam that advances segment by segment, hits each foe on the line once for the full power, and stops at a block.
Deals about %1$s Tera energy damage; the type is your effective primary type at the moment of release (temporary retypes included).
At release, Attack minus Sp. Atk is %1$s: above 0 it crystallizes into a spear (physical, knocks the first target back); below 0 it fires a beam (special). That side is fixed once the shot leaves.
The spear's radius is about %1$s blocks; the beam is about %2$s blocks wide and advances about %3$s blocks per tick, and each foe on the line is settled once per cast.
Hurled within %1$s blocks; every foe the beam crosses flashes briefly at its own position, and only a real block contact cracks at the wall; otherwise it fades out at the end of its range.
worldcombat.skill.terablast.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.terablast.preference.a: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to cast Tera Blast; when off it stays put.
